## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the user.

## Validation

List relevant checks and results. For documentation-only changes, note which
runtime checks are not applicable and verify links/examples instead.

## Review notes

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves current-task fidelity and profile scope.
- [ ] Tests/examples use synthetic data; no profiles, conversations, credentials or private reports are included.
- [ ] Available behavior is distinguished from planned or unverified behavior.

Mention material compatibility, permission or data-migration effects, if any.
